outputs.explanation: This is a scatter plot where each of the 141 samples is plotted individually; the points themselves are the individual data, so no overlay is needed.

Each marker represents the mean (±s.d.) of 6 replicate samples per cell line/reporter, but the underlying individual replicate measurements are not shown; only the averaged value with an error bar is plotted.
This is a line/density plot (fitted normal/gamma distributions), a plot type exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Box plots are shown with individual sample data points (dots) overlaid on each box.
Polar histograms show phase differences averaged across multiple replicates per cell line, but the individual replicate phase-difference values are not overlaid or otherwise shown.

Polar histogram shows subtype-averaged phase differences (averaged over 1-4 cell line models each already averaged over replicates), without display of the individual underlying cell-line or replicate values.
This is an example/illustrative line plot of a single fitted signal trace, a line plot type exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
This is a scatter plot where each of the 117 samples is plotted as an individual point (with fit-uncertainty error bars); the points themselves constitute the individual data.
